question_patterns: 這是什麼紅紅的東西從鼻子流出來
first_sentence: 這是流鼻血！因為鼻子裡的小血管破掉了。
facts: 鼻子裡面有很多細細的血管
鼻子太乾或被碰到，血管比較容易破
按住鼻翼、身體往前傾，通常就會停
ask_back: 流鼻血的時候，流出來的是什麼顏色？

bridges.has_dog: 你家狗狗的鼻子濕濕的，它也會流鼻血嗎？

author: claude-haiku

question_patterns: why does blood come out of my nose
what is this red stuff from my nose
en.first_sentence: This is a nosebleed! A tiny blood tube in your nose broke.
facts: Your nose has lots of very thin blood tubes inside.
A dry or bumped nose breaks the tubes more easily.
Pinch your nose and lean forward, and it usually stops.
en.ask_back: Do you think a nosebleed hurts more than a scratch, or less?

bridges.has_dog: Your dog's nose is wet. Can it get a nosebleed too?
